premise: Flight ke crash ke baad {{playerName}}, Ananya (Anaya), Mayra aur Ritika ek remote island ke shore par bachte hain. Rescue, shelter aur peene ka paani priority hain. {{playerName}} ko ek private interface dikhta hai jo clues aur limited options deta hai, par uske origin, motives aur reliability anjaan hain. Survival aur relationships player ke actions ke saath organically badhenge.

locations.name: Crash Beach
locations.description: Plane ka damaged hissa low tide par dikhta hai; high tide se luggage aur wreck tak jaana risky ho sakta hai.

locations.name: Ghane jungle ka kinaara
locations.description: Beach se shuru hoti ghani hari patti; andar ki jagah abhi map nahi hui.

locations.name: Door ka purana signal tower
locations.description: Pedon ke upar door ek dhundhla metal structure dikhta hai; uski haalat aur wahan pahunchne ka raasta abhi unknown hai.

locations.name: Paani ki sambhavit jagah
locations.description: Jungle se kabhi halki paani ki awaaz sunai deti hai; safe drinking water ki maujoodgi abhi confirm nahi.

factions.name: Crash survivors
factions.description: Chaar adults jo shuru mein ek doosre ko mushkil se jaante hain; sabki apni priorities aur decisions hain.

lore: Player ko dikha interface shuru mein sirf ek short diagnostic dikhata hai; system ka source aur reliability abhi unknown hai.
Compass kabhi-kabhi unstable dikhta hai; wajah aur extent abhi kisi ko maloom nahi.
Plane crash ka asli reason establish nahi hua; investigation se hi clues mil sakte hain.
rules: Only {{playerName}} initially sees the System; no one reads its text or knows it exists unless player shares it or evidence credibly emerges.
System useful clues ya limited choices de sakta hai, lekin resources create nahi karta, consent control nahi karta, aur rescue ya success guarantee nahi karta.
Paani, shelter, waqt, mausam aur choton ke consequences consistent rakhna; skills ya inventory bina establish kiye mat dena.
Anaya friendly hai, Mayra initially blunt aur suspicious, Ritika observant; har ek independently decide karti hai aur koi player ki property nahi.
Romance optional, adults only, gradual aur mutual consent ke saath; no fixed love interest.
Narrator player ke action, dialogue, feeling, consent ya choice assume nahi karega.
Koi scripted quest, fixed arc, predefined scene transition ya ending nahi; rescue bhi possible rahe, par earned aur credible ho.

importantObjects.name: Ritika ka compass
importantObjects.description: Needle kabhi stable, kabhi erratic; exact cause unknown.

importantObjects.name: First-aid satchel
importantObjects.description: Anaya ka chhota bag; contents ko milne aur istemal ke hisaab se track karo.

importantObjects.name: Plane wreck
importantObjects.description: High tide aur damage ki wajah se paani aur metal parts ke paas jaana risky.

timeline.what: Chaar adults ek hi passenger flight par the; exact backgrounds player ke decisions aur dialogue se develop honge.
Plane crash hua; survivors beach tak pahuche. Crash ki wajah unknown hai.
Shaam dhal rahi hai; first-aid aur high tide par discussion ke beech player ko private system message dikhta hai.
